Chapter 6491: Ancestors, Please Come

Chapter 6491: Ancestors, Please Come

“Boom!” Seventy-two Origin Ancestor’s group became resplendent as the endless force of life coursed through them.

Their grand formation activated without them needing to fuse. This was the difference between longevity and paragon force. The former seemed to be alive and could automatically shift.

“Longevity to Immortality Strike!” The formation transformed into a palm of the overlord level, aiming for North Kun God.

Seventy-two and the others were amazed at the automatic nature of Paramount’s life force. It had no concept of time and space, instantly appearing before North Kun.

The endless life force couldn’t be beaten since there would always be subsequent waves. The palm existed today, tomorrow, and the next in perpetuity. Therefore, North Kun faced countless palm strikes stacked upon each other in a temporal phenomenon.

He brought his rune back defensively. The impact cracked the dream realm and made him vomit blood.

The rune saved him but this still displayed the difference in power.

“I’m afraid you are outmatched today, Fellow Daoist.” The woman’s voice instilled immense pressure since she had control of two great dream realms.

“Amazing, looks like your victory is inevitable.” North Kun said.

“We’ve waited long for today.” She said: “If you die, is there anyone else in Desolate Frontier that can fight? Everlasting Jiang and Tenth-gen Chen are gone, no one can uphold the banner any longer.”

Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect, Trinity Kingdom, and Immortal Gate formed an unprecedented alliance under her leadership.

Although they were on the same side before, they didn’t cooperate closely. Now, they willingly shared the dream powers.

“Looks like you came to Old World with a plan.” North Kun said.

“Just a coincidence.” Her response didn’t convince the crowd.

Some among them must have been finding the remnant legacies of Heavenly Sin’s fallen world in Uncrossable Expanse.

Rumor has it Staff Ancestor found something here that helped her ascension to the overlord level. Bodhi Ancestor was another lucky adventurer who found something.

Thus, people never stopped searching for Heavenly Sin’s artifacts.

“Either way, it doesn’t matter. My death means nothing, Desolate Frontier will still stand strong.” North Kun laughed.

The enemies exchanged glances and found truth in this. Desolate Frontier’s root and foundation surpassed their sects.

If their sects were to be destroyed right now, there was no rebuilding. Although they were allies of Moshi once, Moshi was no longer around and wouldn’t have helped either since the ties were shallow.

“True, but your defeat is certain.” She said.

“Come then.” He took a deep breath, preparing to fight again.

“Boom!” Suddenly, Gold Village opened its gate again.

“Ancestors, please come and hide here!” Alch-deer’s voice came from within.

North Kun, Whale, and Stoneboiler exchanged glances and came to an understanding.

“Retreat!” All three rushed toward Gold Village.

Although this was shameful given their stature, they had no chance against two major realms. North Kun needed to become a supreme overlord first. Since Gold Village was still around, they could use it to avoid the crushing defeat.

The woman watched their escape with furrowed brows.
